
```
svc_restart(namespace="default", service="jobs")
```

3. Read the recent logs for the jobs service to see if there are any error messages that might indicate why jobs are failing:

```
read_logs(service="jobs")
```


6. After that, I'll clean up the failed jobs that are no longer needed by deleting them from the jobs table using `db_delete`.

```
db_delete(table="failed_jobs", where="status='failed'")
```

